# MM-P1-L4-HP02-S2 Fastener inspection and torque - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2
Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

Scope
This document defines the required fastener inspection, lubrication item identification, and torque verification workflow for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02). It supplements general procedures in SOP-P1-L4-03 and engineering changes in ECN-2026-047.

Tools
- Visual inspection light
- Torque verification device calibrated per SB-1012
- Clean lint-free rags
- Approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-195
- Maintenance log and equipment tag

Procedure
- Prepare equipment per lockout/tagout and SOP-P1-L4-03. Verify torque verification device calibration per SB-1012 before use.
- Visually inspect all accessible fasteners on EQ-P1-L4-HP02 for evidence of movement, fretting, corrosion, or thread damage. Replace hardware only with items specified in ECN-2026-047 or approved equivalents.
- Clean fastener contact surfaces with lint-free rags. Apply lubricant CFW-LUB-195 only where specified by ECN-2026-047 and SOP-P1-L4-03.
- Verify torque using the torque verification device. Record results in the maintenance log and tag the press with date and inspector ID as required by site practice.
- Perform hydraulic oil change in accordance with plant schedule. Note: The hydraulic oil change interval for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 2680 hours. Coordinate oil change activities with production and document in the maintenance log.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible thread damage, galling, or corrosion on inspected fasteners.
- Torque verification results documented and within limits specified by ECN-2026-047 or SOP-P1-L4-03.
- Lubricant applied is CFW-LUB-195 where required and logged.
- Hydraulic oil change performed and recorded at the hydraulic oil change interval for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L4-HP02) is 2680 hours.

Related documents
ECN-2026-047, SB-1012, SOP-P1-L4-03
